# TechAccountingPro

> Technical accounting firm for digital companies: Web3 protocols, digital asset businesses, and AI startups. Big 4 (KPMG) trained, led by founder Andrei Belonogov (PhD, CPA, FCCA). US GAAP reporting, technical accounting memos, audit readiness, token accounting, and AI revenue and cost accounting, delivered on a subscription basis. Founded March 2022, headquartered in Louisville, KY, serving clients worldwide.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://techaccountingpro.com/#services): financial reporting, accounting strategy (ASC 606, including usage-based and credit-based AI pricing; going concern), technical accounting (business combinations, SAFEs, consolidation, software and AI model development cost capitalization, GPU and cloud compute commitments), technical crypto accounting (token grants, SAFTs, token compensation, staking, DAO/foundation consolidation), change management (IFRS to US GAAP, ERP conversion), process and governance.
